summary: Frontend testing of 3 new features: Water Practices, Gene Keys, and Human Design pages. All features verified working correctly with 100% pass rate.
critical_code_review_comments: WaterPractices.jsx: Well-structured with 4 category tabs (blessing, crystalline, cleansing, moon). All practice cards clickable with detailed modals showing materials, steps, sacred words, and affirmations.

GeneKeys.jsx: Complete 64 Gene Keys data with Shadow/Gift/Siddhi for each key. 4 tabs (Overview, 64 Gene Keys, Golden Path, Contemplation) all working. Draw Today's Gene Key button generates random key correctly.

HumanDesign.jsx: 5 Energy Types (Generator, Manifesting Generator, Projector, Manifestor, Reflector) with detailed modals showing Strategy, Aura, Signature, Not-Self, Key Traits, Deconditioning, and Affirmation. 9 Centers and 13 key Gates displayed.
MainMenu.jsx: Water Practices correctly placed under Sacred Temples section. Gene Keys and Human Design correctly placed under Divination & Guidance section.

All data-testid attributes present: water-practices, gene-keys, human-design, category-{id}, tab-{id}, key-{n}, type-{id}, center-{name}, gate-{n}, sequence-{id}, menu-water-practices, menu-gene-keys, menu-human-design.
